import os
print(os.path.exists('/work/textmask.py'))
print(open('/work/textmask.py').read() if os.path.exists('/work/textmask.py') else "MISSING")

import subprocess, re as re_mod

# Load module fresh
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("textmask", "/work/textmask.py")
tm = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(tm)

def old_masked(text, name):
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split("-")), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re_mod.sub(r"\b" + re_mod.escape(tok) + r"\b", "x", t)
    return t

tests = [
    ("The Fowler Refactoring skill helps with fowler-refactoring tasks", "fowler-refactoring"),
    ("ab-cd name with ab and cd parts, also abcd", "ab-cd"),
    ("No match here at all", "zzz-yyy"),
    ("Mixed CASE Name mixed-case appears here", "Mixed-Case"),
    ("single", "single"),
    ("short a-b tokens should be skipped due to length<3", "a-b"),
    ("duplicate-duplicate test of same token twice", "duplicate-duplicate"),
]

all_ok = True
for text, name in tests:
    new_out = tm.masked(text, name)
    old_out = old_masked(text, name)
    ok = new_out == old_out
    all_ok &= ok
    print(repr(name), "->", ok, repr(new_out))

print("ALL MATCH:", all_ok)

# check name_tokens itself
print(tm.name_tokens("fowler-refactoring"))
print(tm.name_tokens("single"))
print(tm.name_tokens("duplicate-duplicate"))

print("imports:", [ast.dump(i) for i in imports])
print("top-level funcs:", funcs)
print("top-level node types:", [type(n).__name__ for n in tree.body])
